Location: The Cottage 58 West End Launton Bicester OX26 5DG. Proposal: Removal of existing outbuilding and log store, erection of annexe ancillary living space. Decision: Permitted. Decision Issued Date: 16/04/2025. Official documents include Proposed Block Plan drawing DWG No. 08-00; Proposed Outbuilding Sections drawing DWG No. 06-02; Proposed Annexe Floor Plan drawing DWG No. 05-03; and Proposed Outbuilding Elevations drawing DWG No. 07-00. The official proposal explicitly removes the existing outbuilding and log store and erects one replacement annexe ancillary living-space structure. The dedicated proposed block, floor, section and elevation drawings support the same single planned annexe. Geometry/materialization is deferred to local OpenCode.
